QuestInfo.name: The Sneakiest Secretary
QuestInfo.1: #p2154002# said she was willing to introduce you to one of the officers. She also said you would get promoted if they liked you. That seems fishy, but this may speed this whole process up! #bJust go in, even if it's a trap#k.
QuestInfo.2: It was a trap. It's not certain how she figured out you were an impostor, but your time sneaking around #m310000000# is over.

0.0: Well then, people of such caliber should be put to good use. I'll #bintroduce you to one of the officers#k right away.
0.1: Officers hold absolute authority within the Black Wings and they are always on the lookout for competent workers. A person as obviously skilled as you will be promoted in no time. Just go into the #broom on the left#k and wait there.

yes.0: Good luck to you! Give it your all! I'm sure I'll be seeing you again one way or another.

no.0: You don't want a promotion? I thought you were ready to be one of the greats!

npc.0: Aww, #rare you nervous#k? Just go on in!
